title: Connection disconnect
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/connections/disconnect, application/json: the source no longer grants this connection access. The control plane ends the connection: its collections take no more items, and their assignments to workspaces end. The change feed carries an unlinked entry for each of them that was linked (changes.schema.json). After the control plane's answer, the adapter drops that connection's collections from its state, and a request for one of them is refused 409 connection_ended. The control plane refuses a connection_id that is unknown or that belongs to another adapter, 403 forbidden, with the same signed body for either cause, and then a connection that already ended, 409 connection_ended, which an adapter takes as the connection ended, as it takes the 204. connection_suspended does not apply to this request: a disconnect of a suspended connection is answered with the signed 204 and ends the connection, so the order is 403, then 409 connection_ended. On success the control plane answers a signed 204 with no body. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

connection_id.description: The connection the source no longer grants access to, as source-collections.schema.json named it.
